messages.content: Help me generate a DMG setup script for an application named 'PhotoEditor' located at '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app', with a custom background image and ensuring the script reflects the correct volume URL and installation directory when creating a macOS package using jpackage?

function.name: MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript
function.description: Prepares a DMG setup script for a macOS application package, including the volume URL, background image file, and installation directory. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

appLocation.description: The file system path string to the application location. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

params.description: A map of parameters that may include the application name, images root, background image folder, and other packaging parameters. This is Java HashMap type parameter in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript with appLocation '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app' and params string containing map of parameters. We need to provide a map with application name, images root, background image folder, etc. The function expects a string representation of a Java HashMap. So we need to pass something like '{"appName":"PhotoEditor","imagesRoot":"/path/to/images","backgroundImageFolder":"bg","volumeURL":"...","installDir":"..."}' but we need to ensure correct volume URL and installation directory. The volume URL is typically something like 'file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor' or similar. The install dir is '/Applications'. For jpackage, the DMG volume name is usually the application name. So volume URL: 'file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor'. Install dir: '/Applications'.

We need to produce a JSON string representing a HashMap. The function will parse it. Provide the map with keys: "appName", "imagesRoot", "backgroundImageFolder", "volumeURL", "installDir". Also maybe "appLocation" is separate param. So we pass appLocation '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app', and params string: '{"appName":"PhotoEditor","imagesRoot":"/path/to/images","backgroundImageFolder":"bg","volumeURL":"file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor","installDir":"/Applications"}'.

We should also mention that the background image path is something like '/path/to/images/bg/background.png'. But we can just set imagesRoot and backgroundImageFolder.

Thus call function.
